mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, increasing dopaminergic and noradrenergic effects of pramipexole, risking hypertensive crisis and serotonin syndrome.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, use with extreme caution under close monitoring for hypertensive episodes, arrhythmias, and serotonergic symptoms; consider alternative antiparkinsonian agents.
